name: @activepieces/piece-textcortex-ai
description: AI-powered writing assistant for content creation, code generation, translations, and more using multiple AI models.

auth.description:
To get your TextCortex API key:
1. Sign up for free at https://textcortex.com
2. Go to your account settings
3. Navigate to the API Key section
4. Generate and copy your API key

Your API key should start with 'gAAAAAB...'

send_prompt.name: send_prompt
send_prompt.description: Send a custom prompt to TextCortex AI and generate a completion.

text.description: Enter the beginning of your text and AI will complete it (e.g., "The benefits of renewable energy are")

formality.description: The formality of the generated text

source_lang.description: The language of the source text

target_lang.description: The language for the generated text

max_tokens.description: Maximum length of generated text (1-4096 tokens)

temperature.description: Controls creativity (0.0-2.0). Higher values = more creative, lower = more focused.

aiMetadata.description: Send a free-form prompt to TextCortex AI and get back generated text completion(s). Choose this for open-ended generation that does not fit a specialized template (paraphrase, summary, translation, email, code, etc.); selectable model, formality, languages, and number of outputs. Not idempotent: each call generates fresh, non-deterministic text and consumes account credits.

create_paraphrase.name: create_paraphrase
create_paraphrase.description: Rewrite text while preserving its meaning.

file_id.description: ID of the file to paraphrase

formality.description: The formality of the generated text

source_lang.description: The language of the source text

target_lang.description: The language for the paraphrased text

max_tokens.description: Maximum length of paraphrased text (1-4096 tokens)

temperature.description: Controls creativity (0.0-2.0). Higher values = more creative, lower = more focused.

aiMetadata.description: Rewrite text via TextCortex AI to express the same meaning in different wording. Provide the content either as inline text or as a stored file ID (one is required); supports a default or embeddings rewrite mode plus model, formality, and language options. Not idempotent: each call produces fresh, non-deterministic output and consumes account credits.

create_social_media_caption.name: create_social_media_caption
create_social_media_caption.description: Generate a caption tailored for a specific social media channel (requires channel and keywords).

context.description: Describe what you want to post about (e.g., "Announcing our new product launch with 50% discount")

mode.description: The platform to generate a post for

keywords.description: Keywords to be included in the post (comma-separated)

formality.description: The formality of the generated text

source_lang.description: The language of the source text

temperature.description: Controls creativity (0.0-2.0). Higher values = more creative, lower = more focused.

aiMetadata.description: Generate a social media caption with TextCortex AI from a description of the post, tuned for a specific platform (Twitter or LinkedIn). Requires the post context and a platform selection; optional comma-separated keywords are woven into the caption. Not idempotent: each call produces fresh, non-deterministic text and consumes account credits.

create_translation.name: create_translation
create_translation.description: Translate input text into a target language.

source_lang.description: The language of the text to translate

formality.description: The formality of the generated text

aiMetadata.description: Translate text into a chosen target language using TextCortex AI. Requires the source text and a target language; source language can be auto-detected, and formality can be controlled. Not idempotent: each call invokes the model fresh and consumes account credits.

create_code.name: create_code
create_code.description: Generate code in a specified programming language based on instructions.

text.description: Describe what you want the code to do (e.g., "Create a function to sort an array")

mode.description: Select the programming language for code generation

max_tokens.description: Maximum length of generated code (1-4096 tokens)

temperature.description: Controls creativity (0.0-2.0). Higher values = more creative, lower = more focused.

n.description: How many code snippets to generate (1-5)

aiMetadata.description: Generate a code snippet with TextCortex AI from a natural-language description of what the code should do. Requires the instructions and a target programming language; selectable model and number of outputs. Not idempotent: each call produces fresh, non-deterministic code and consumes account credits.

create_email.name: create_email
create_email.description: Compose an email using context, recipient ("To"), and sender ("From") metadata.

context.description: Context of the email. For example, a summary, or a bullet point list

mode.description: The style or tone to be used when writing

instructions.description: Instructions for the email. Available when mode = reply

received_email.description: The email that is being replied to. Available when mode = reply

purpose.description: Purpose of the email. Available when mode = cold

company_details.description: Details regarding the company. Available when mode = customer_support

formality.description: The formality of the generated text

source_lang.description: The language of the source text

temperature.description: Controls creativity (0.0-2.0). Higher values = more creative, lower = more focused.

n.description: How many email drafts to generate (1-5)

aiMetadata.description: Draft an email with TextCortex AI from supplied context plus optional sender/recipient. Pick an email mode (reply, general, customer support, cold, or from-bullets) which unlocks mode-specific inputs such as the received email and instructions for replies, purpose for cold outreach, or company details for support. Not idempotent: each call produces fresh, non-deterministic text and consumes account credits.

create_product_description.name: create_product_description
create_product_description.description: Create a product description using details like name, brand, category, features, keywords.

keywords.description: Keywords to include in the product description (comma-separated)

formality.description: The formality of the generated text

source_lang.description: The language of the source text

target_lang.description: The language for the product description

max_tokens.description: Maximum length of product description (1-4096 tokens)

temperature.description: Controls creativity (0.0-2.0). Higher values = more creative, lower = more focused.

aiMetadata.description: Generate a marketing product description with TextCortex AI from product attributes (name, brand, category, features, and comma-separated keywords). All fields are optional, so supply whatever product details are available; model, formality, and language are configurable. Not idempotent: each call produces fresh, non-deterministic text and consumes account credits.

create_summary.name: create_summary
create_summary.description: Summarize input text to concise form.

file_id.description: ID of the file to summarize

formality.description: The formality of the generated text

source_lang.description: The language of the source text

temperature.description: Controls creativity (0.0-2.0). Higher values = more creative, lower = more focused.

aiMetadata.description: Condense text into a shorter summary using TextCortex AI. Provide the content either as inline text or as a stored file ID (one is required); supports a default or embeddings summarization mode plus model, formality, and language options. Not idempotent: each call produces fresh, non-deterministic output and consumes account credits.

de.AI-powered writing assistant for content: KI-gestützter Schreibassistent für die Erstellung von Inhalten, Code-Generierung, Übersetzungen und mehr mit mehreren KI-Modellen.
de.To get your TextCortex API key:\n1. Sign:
Um Ihren TextCortex-API-Schlüssel zu erhalten:
1. Melden Sie sich kostenlos unter https://textcortex.com
2. Gehen Sie zu Ihren Kontoeinstellungen
3. Navigieren Sie zum API-Schlüssel Abschnitt
4. Generieren und kopieren Sie Ihren API-Schlüssel

Ihr API-Schlüssel sollte mit 'gAAAAAB...' beginnen
de.Send a custom prompt to TextCortex AI an: Senden Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Eingabeaufforderung an TextCortex KI und generieren Sie eine Fertigstellung.
de.Rewrite text while preserving its meanin: Text neu schreiben, ohne seine Bedeutung zu verlieren.
de.Generate a caption tailored for a specif: Generieren Sie eine Beschriftung zugeschnitten auf einen bestimmten Social Media Kanal (erfordert Kanal und Schlüsselwörter).
de.Generate code in a specified programming: Generieren Sie Code in einer bestimmten Programmiersprache basierend auf Anweisungen.
de.Compose an email using context, recipien: Erstellen Sie eine E-Mail unter Verwendung von Kontexten, Empfängern ("An") und Absender ("Von") Metadaten.
de.Create a product description using detai: Erstellen Sie eine Produktbeschreibung mit Details wie Name, Marke, Kategorie, Features, Schlüsselwörter.
Zusammenfassung des Eingabetextes zur Zusammenfassung des Formulars.
de.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Einen benutzerdefinierten API-Aufruf an einen bestimmten Endpunkt machen
de.Enter the beginning of your text and AI: Geben Sie den Anfang Ihres Textes ein und die KI wird ihn vervollständigen (z. B. "Die Vorteile erneuerbarer Energien sind")
de.The language for the generated text: Die Sprache für den generierten Text
de.Maximum length of generated text (1-4096: Maximale Länge des generierten Textes (1-4096 Token)
de.Controls creativity (0.0-2.0). Higher va: Kontrolliert Kreativität (0.0-2.0). Höhere Werte = kreativer, niedriger = fokussierter.
de.How many completions to generate (1-5): Wie viele Vervollständigungen generiert werden sollen (1-5)
de.The language for the paraphrased text: Die Sprache für den paraphrasierten Text
de.Maximum length of paraphrased text (1-40: Maximale Länge des paraphrasierten Textes (1-4096 Token)
de.How many paraphrases to generate (1-5): Wie viele Paraphrasen generiert werden sollen (1-5)
Beschreiben Sie, worüber Sie posten möchten (z.B.: "Ankündigung unserer neuen Produkteinführung mit 50% Rabatt")
de.The platform to generate a post for: Die Plattform, um einen Beitrag zu erstellen für
de.Keywords to be included in the post (com: Stichworte, die in den Beitrag aufgenommen werden sollen (kommagetrennt)
de.How many captions to generate (1-5): Wie viele Bildunterschriften generiert werden sollen (1-5)
de.The language of the text to translate: Die Sprache des zu übersetzenden Textes
de.Describe what you want the code to do (e: Beschreiben Sie, was der Code tun soll (z.B. "Erstelle eine Funktion um ein Array zu sortieren")
de.Select the programming language for code: Wählen Sie die Programmiersprache für die Codegenerierung
de.Maximum length of generated code (1-4096: Maximale Länge des generierten Codes (1-4096 Token)
de.How many code snippets to generate (1-5): Wie viele Code-Snippets generiert werden sollen (1-5)
de.Context of the email. For example, a sum: Kontext der E-Mail. Zum Beispiel eine Zusammenfassung oder eine Kugelpunktliste
de.The style or tone to be used when writin: Der Stil oder Ton, der beim Schreiben verwendet werden soll
de.Instructions for the email. Available wh: Anleitung für die E-Mail. Verfügbar im Modus = Antwort
de.The email that is being replied to. Avai: Die E-Mail, auf die geantwortet wird. Verfügbar wenn Modus = Antwort
de.Purpose of the email. Available when mod: Zweck der E-Mail. Verfügbar wenn Modus = kalt
de.Details regarding the company. Available: Details zum Unternehmen. Verfügbar wenn mode = customer_support
de.Keywords to include in the product descr: Keywords die in die Produktbeschreibung eingefügt werden sollen (durch Komma getrennt)
de.How many descriptions to generate (1-5): Wie viele Beschreibungen generiert werden sollen (1-5)
de.How many summaries to generate (1-5): Wie viele Zusammenfassungen generiert werden sollen (1-5)
